title: Lagged Bitcoin on-chain activity breadth full-capital long/cash timing
thesis: Sustained growth in both transaction count and active-address participation may identify a broader network-use state than either noisy proxy alone. Holding unlevered BTC only when both lagged four-week activity means exceed their corresponding levels 52 weeks earlier may reduce weak-network paths without forfeiting too much after-cost upside.
mechanism: For complete UTC observation day D, compute the 28-day simple means of TxCnt and AdrActCnt and compare each with the 28-day mean ending exactly 364 days earlier. At D plus two calendar days 00:00 UTC, hold 100-percent BTC only if both comparisons are strictly positive; otherwise hold zero-yield cash. TxCnt-only and AdrActCnt-only policies are frozen rejection neighbors.
economic_rationale: The policy is useful only if a causally distinct network-use state improves drawdown and Calmar enough to offset missed BTC participation and switching costs. Aggregate PnL, one crisis exit, present-vintage correlation or terminal inventory appreciation is insufficient.
